April 21, 1971
2014-12-09T00:02:04+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/april-21-1971-54442

The temporary president of Bangladesh Government Syed Nazrul Islam appoints Justice Abu Saeed Chowdhury as the special representative of the Bangladesh Diplomatic mission in foreign countries

One company of army men of the Bengal Regiment under the command of Major Imamuzzaman quit Laksham and moves to Mia Bazaar in Comilla and takes defence there.

20 freedom fighters attack one group of Pakistan military in Jessore, Nabharon ghaati. This results in the death of 10 Pakistan military and left 15 injured.
